purpose: API key issuance (GET/POST/DELETE /api/keys): list prefixes, mint a new key (plaintext returned once), revoke.

purpose: Origin-blind metered scholarly search endpoint: resolves identity, gates credits, fans out to server-safe adapters, scores/deduplicates/fuses with RRF, and returns public or admin-debug cards.

purpose: User settings GET/POST: AES-256-GCM encrypted blob persisted in users.settings (JSONB).
notes: POST reads req.body directly (framework-parsed) instead of parseBody — inconsistent with other routes. Decrypt failure falls back to null (client uses localStorage).

purpose: Chronic-failure circuit-breaker (v0.38): an in-process, instance-scoped consecutive-failure streak per adapter id; once it crosses FAILURE_STREAK_THRESHOLD the adapter is dropped from the eligible set before coverage, so a permanently-broken source can't pin the coverage band below full or under-charge.
notes: State resets on cold start by design (transient outages self-clear; a still-broken adapter re-opens within FAILURE_STREAK_THRESHOLD requests). Unit-tested in api/_shared/adapterHealth.test.js.

purpose: Resolves an incoming request to a billing identity via master-key, hashed API-key DB lookup, or session-admin allowlist; server-derives the admin flag.
notes: Master key compared with === (not timingSafeEqual). ADMIN_EMAILS read from VITE_ADMIN_EMAILS|ADMIN_EMAILS env. last_used_at stamp is fire-and-forget.

purpose: Single definition of /api/search request parameters, response envelope, coverage bands, and formats; consumed by the search handler and future MCP/OpenAPI generators.
notes: Origin-blind by design — RESULT_FIELDS omits source. DRY-4 SSOT for MCP tool schema (WS4, deferred).

purpose: TRUSTED_ORIGINS SSOT, the OWN_VERCEL_HOST_RE / isTrustedOrigin / isTrustedHost trust helpers (reused by checkout + requireInternalOrigin), origin-aware CORS header setter, and getSession (loopback Auth.js session fetch).
notes: v0.39: getSession now pins the loopback host via isTrustedHost (F-401 fixed); setCorsHeaders + checkout.baseUrl use isTrustedOrigin, replacing the loose endsWith('.vercel.app') that trusted any Vercel project (F-415 fixed). OWN_VERCEL_HOST_RE matches opencite*.vercel.app previews only.

purpose: Two-phase credit ledger: preAuthorize (atomic compare-and-decrement), settle (coverage-prorated refund), refund, grantCredits, applyMonthlyGrant (idempotent per-month top-up).
notes: preAuthorize uses updateMany with gte guard — atomic compare-and-decrement, no overspend. applyMonthlyGrant accepts {client:tx} for webhook transactional use.

purpose: Caches the final origin-blind /api/search JSON payload in KV (Upstash/Vercel KV), keyed by SHA-256 of result-affecting inputs; fail-open.
notes: Cache key prefix oc:cache:v1:. TTL 6h. mailto excluded from key (polite-pool only). Debug/simple modes never read or write cache.

purpose: Forward (cited-by) + backward (references) citation-graph traversal on an OpenAlex backbone with an OpenCitations CC0 fallback for bare-DOI backward lookups; clean-room port of neuromechanist/opencite citations.py (MIT).
notes: Semantic Scholar deliberately NOT wired (keys approval-gated, 429s even when keyed — Appendix A.4). Pipeline-order invariant: dedup → sort → truncate — never truncate the raw unsorted list first. OpenAlex batch-by-id capped at 25/OR-group (live probe). Distinct circuit-breaker ids OPENALEX_GRAPH/OPENCITATIONS so graph health never collides with search-adapter streaks. OpenCitations TTL 7 days (lookup-only, slow ~900ms warm). TODO(reuse): swap inline OpenCitations fetch for an adopted OpenCitations adapter when one lands.

purpose: Corpus-weighted coverage ratio bucketed into a coarse band; single SSOT for both the API response band and the billing multiplier.
notes: Only the band string is safe to emit externally — raw %, failedCount, and adapter names are internal only.

purpose: Two strictly separated crypto families: AES-256-GCM for the settings blob, SHA-256+pepper for API key hashing and generation.
notes: API_KEY_PEPPER is optional — if unset, hashes are unpepped (offline brute-force risk on DB leak). getSettingsKey() throws on missing/wrong-length env — fail-closed.

purpose: Admin-only origin-revealing card: composes toPublicResult and appends source, _score, _fused, _native, _scoreBreakdown.
notes: HARD INVARIANT: only callable when identity.admin === true. source is the single field that breaks origin-blindness.

purpose: Dependency-free Upstash REST client for rate limiting and result caching; fail-open by contract.
notes: Config priority: KV_REST_API_URL+KV_REST_API_TOKEN then UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_URL+UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_TOKEN. claimOnce is the idempotency primitive (INCR-based, unambiguous vs SET NX).

purpose: Structured console logger for server-side routes; format [opencite:<adapter>:<event>] k=v.
notes: Duplicate of src/lib/log.js format — see R-400.

purpose: Shared auth + rate-limit + two-phase credit charge scaffolding for the additive v0.43 endpoints (/api/citations, /api/ids); /api/search keeps its own inline path and is intentionally NOT refactored onto this.
notes: Single-source endpoints (citations, ids) always pass band='full' to charge() → 1 credit. Admin plan.creditCost=0 → ledger untouched. charge() refunds on any thrown error — never bills a failed call.

purpose: Reads Node.js IncomingMessage body stream and JSON-parses it; returns {} on parse error.
notes: No maximum body size — Vercel's 4.5MB platform limit is the only bound.

purpose: Single definition of billing plans, credit packs, and plan-derived queries (tier source IDs, Stripe Price IDs, monthly grants); server-authoritative.

purpose: PrismaClient singleton cached on globalThis for serverless warm-start reuse.
notes: globalThis caching only active in non-production (NODE_ENV check). Production cold-starts always get a fresh client.

purpose: Maps an internal normalized record to the origin-blind public card: drops source, replaces id with anonymizeId, rounds score.

purpose: Fixed-window KV rate limiter: burst cap per (identity, epoch), separate from the durable credit ledger; fail-open.
notes: Admin plan.rateLimit.max===0 bypasses check without KV access. KV unavailable → fail-open (allow).

purpose: Internal-origin guard (v0.39) for the keyed browser-shim routes: accepts Sec-Fetch-Site same-origin/same-site or a trusted Origin/Referer; 403s direct/cross-site callers so the discoverable URLs can't burn paid upstream quota (F-407).
notes: Browsers omit Origin on same-origin GET, so an Origin-only check would 403 legitimate search; Sec-Fetch-Site (a forbidden, browser-set header) is the primary signal. Soft quota guard, not a hard auth boundary — Origin/Referer are forgeable by non-browser clients.

purpose: Only place EUROPEANA_API_KEY, DPLA_API_KEY, SMITHSONIAN_API_KEY are read from env; returns only keys that are set.

purpose: Stripe webhook handler: verifies signature, claims events in processedEvent (idempotent), grants credits/sets plan in a single atomic transaction.

purpose: Factory function createLauncher() — enforces the launcher object shape (id, name, tagline, region, archiveType, contentType, buildUrl).
Registry of 23 external archive launchers (no queryable API — opens pre-filled search in new tab), grouped by region.
Client-side admin gate — isAdmin(user) checks user.email against VITE_ADMIN_EMAILS env var (comma-separated).
Thin generic fetch wrapper with credentials:include and Content-Type:application/json for all API routes.

purpose: Result identity and deduplication: doiKey (strongest), titleFingerprint (fuzzy same-paper); dedupFirstWins for streaming (first-occurrence wins), dedupHighestScore for pooled (highest _score wins).
notes: v0.42: dedupHighestScore replacement is now O(1) via a posMap (F-206), and a collision ENRICHES the survivor with the loser's better fields via mergeRecords (F-210, the sprint's "F-208") instead of discarding it. Pooled path only — dedupFirstWins (streaming) cannot merge. Covered by src/lib/dedup.test.js.

purpose: nDCG@10, MRR, and Recall@N metrics engine for the F2 Gold-Set Regression Harness in the admin console; grades results against a DOI/title → relevance-grade label map.
notes: Unit-tested in goldSetMetrics.test.js. Imported by components/admin/GoldSetHarness.jsx — NOT orphaned. Not called during live search.

purpose: Clusters book-chapter results under their container/book title for the source-view layout; non-chapter results pass through as single-item groups.
notes: Render-time only — not called during scoring or dedup.

purpose: Utility functions: reconstructAbstract (OpenAlex inverted index), truncate (word-boundary safe), stripHtml.
localStorage-backed search history CRUD — add (dedup+cap at HISTORY_MAX=50), remove, load, clear.

Isomorphic identifier resolution (detectIdType, resolveIds, canonicalDoi) over the NCBI PMC ID Converter, with a shared token-bucket limiter (key 'ncbi_eutils'); feeds the pre-dedup DOI canonicalizer (v0.43 T2.2, attacks v0.35 D5 fragmentation) and /api/ids.
notes: Clean-room from neuromechanist/opencite id_converter.py + base.py (MIT). No Node-only imports — fetch/performance.now are global in Node ≥18 and browsers. Mixed-type batches rejected by NCBI; inputs are split into homogeneous groups with explicit idtype before each request. 429 returned as a JSON body (not just HTTP status) — parsed defensively; the whole batch is treated as unresolved rather than throwing. Process-local token bucket: limits per warm Vercel instance, not globally (same caveat as adapterHealth.js).

purpose: Maps ISO 639-1, ISO 639-2, and full English language names to a canonical {code, display} pair; returns null for undetermined/undifferentiated codes.
notes: Used by adapters to normalise language codes from API responses.

purpose: localStorage-backed library CRUD — add/remove/has/load/clear, keyed by DOI or source:id.
Client-side ring buffer logger (500 entries) — structured [opencite:adapter:event] format; installDebugLog() activates buffering + global error handlers for admins.
notes: Buffer only active when installDebugLog() is called (admin sign-in). Distinct from api/_shared/log.js (server-side).

purpose: Runtime platform detection (web/ios/android) — routes subscription checkout to Stripe or IAP; reads window.__OPENCITE_PLATFORM__ or Capacitor.

Weighted Reciprocal Rank Fusion: scale-free merger of native, lexical, and semantic rank lists; also provides buildNativeRanks (per-source dense rank map) and nativeWeight (pool-size-aware native share).
notes: Used by hooks.useSemanticRerank (client). Not yet called by api.search (server) — F-209 open gap.

purpose: BM25F content-relevance scorer (SSOT): tokenises title/abstract/keywords with NFKD normalisation, computes per-pool IDF, applies phrase/proximity boosts, capability-gated citation tiebreak and thin-source prior; also exports hasContentMatch and applyConfidenceGate.
notes: D1/D2/D5 are FIXED in current source. D3/D4 partially fixed (client UI path uses RRF; server path still raw BM25F). IDF is per-pool over 14-45 docs — degenerate by design until v0.35 T2 server extension.

purpose: Manages the embed.worker singleton, dispatches embedding jobs via a promise Map keyed by msgId, constructs the title+abstract+keywords input string within a 512-char budget, returns a cosine-similarity rank Map.
notes: Worker runs Xenova/all-MiniLM-L6-v2 (~23MB) from CDN, browser-cached. Cannot run server-side — Web Worker API unavailable in Vercel Functions.

purpose: Namespaced localStorage wrapper — prefixes all keys with 'opencite:'; get/set/remove with JSON serialization and try/catch.
Score-side term expansion (original query to APIs unchanged): 16 hand-curated academic clusters (synchronous) + Moby Thesaurus II letter-keyed shards (async, CDN-fetched, shard-cached).
notes: MAX_MOBY_SYNS=24 cap. Shard files are large (some letters >2MB JSON). v0.42 (F-207): loadShard now fetches+parses inside workers.synonyms.worker off the main thread, with an inline main-thread fallback when Worker is undefined (SSR/tests).

purpose: Vite entry point — mounts the React tree via ReactDOM.createRoot with StrictMode.
Shebang stdio entrypoint for the MCP server; calls startStdioServer() and exits 1 on failure.
REST client for /api/search: enforces TLS, 30s timeout, forwards x-api-key, never logs headers.
notes: v0.43: extended with client functions for /api/citations and /api/ids (searchCitations, resolveIds). Structural scan will pick up the new exports.

purpose: DRY-4 bridge: re-exports API_CONTRACT/PARAMS/RESULT_FIELDS/RESPONSE_SHAPE/COVERAGE_BANDS from apiContract.js; defines TOOL_PARAM_MAP (query→q, limit, format) and toRestQuery().
Schema generators driven from contract.js: mcpInputSchema(), functionSchemas() (OpenAI + Anthropic), openApiSpec() — single source produces all agent-integration artifacts.
Creates the MCP Server object; registers ListTools and CallTool handlers; reads OPENCITE_API_KEY and OPENCITE_API_BASE_URL from env.
notes: v0.43: two new tools added — search_citations (wraps /api/citations, dir=cited-by|refs) and resolve_ids (wraps /api/ids, DOI↔PMID↔PMCID). Structural scan will pick up code; this note records the curated intent.

purpose: Root package: defines build chain (migrate.mjs → tailwindcss → vite build), postinstall prisma generate, and all runtime/dev deps.
Prisma schema: User, Account, Session, VerificationToken, search_history, library_items, ApiKey, ApiUsage, ProcessedEvent, relevance_labels — all models for auth, billing, history, and gold-set.
Admin debug probe: drives /api/search with admin key + debug=1; prints origin-revealing envelope (per-adapter table, dedup trace, coverage, ranked results with source). --assert-admin CI mode.
Origin-blind regression guardrail: sends debug=1 with a non-admin key; asserts meta.debug absent and no result.source field. Exit 0=PASS, 1=FAIL.
P3005-safe migration runner: tries prisma migrate deploy; falls back to direct SQL apply + baseline; always exits 0 to never block deploys.
Public endpoint stress/quality probe (no auth); outputs compact JSON per query for relevance QA. Infers origin heuristically from public fields.
In-process smoke test for ?simple=1 diagnostic mode (v0.36): imports api/search.js handler directly with mock req/res; asserts T1.3 invariants (simpleMode, source visible, no score).
Tailwind config: standard content scan over index.html + src/**. No custom plugins or theme extensions.
Vercel deploy config: /api/auth/* → handler rewrite, SPA fallback for all non-API paths. Serverless functions auto-detected from api/*.js.
Minimal Vite config: React plugin only. No aliases, chunks, proxy, or SSR.
Loads and runs all-MiniLM-L6-v2 via @xenova/transformers@2.17.2 from jsDelivr CDN; handles embed messages, returns L2-normalised embedding arrays.
notes: Model is cached in IndexedDB after first load via env.useBrowserCache=true. Pipeline singleton — only one instance regardless of message count.

purpose: Fetches and JSON-parses Moby Thesaurus shards off the main thread; caches parsed shards in-worker and replies with an entries array the main thread rebuilds into a Map.
notes: Added v0.42 (F-207): moves the ~4MB 'c'-shard JSON parse off the main thread. lib.synonyms falls back to an inline main-thread fetch when Worker is undefined (SSR/tests).
